Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, David Strah, Phil Reed, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. "Condom Consciousness Day" at NYU, distribution of condoms 3. President Reagan and his non-stance on AIDS testing, and public policy COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 4. Discussion of politicians in-the-running for the Democratic nomination and their pro or anti-gay stance COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 5. News Watch, AIDS drug, DDC, enters preliminary human testing 6. Record book of 500 people tested for the HIV virus has been stolen, presumably by blackmailers 7. Alliance for Gay and Lesbian Artists closes its offices and lays off its staff 8. Coverage and clips from NYC's "Stamp Out AIDS Day" 9. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 10. Lavender Health, interview with Donna Futterman, pediatrician and co-author of a lesbian parenting book 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Show Bits with George Trahanis, review of "Waving Goodbye" COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine 2. Naming Names, criticism of Jerry Falwell COMMERCIAL: The Monster 3. South Padre Island, Texas, gay resort location Lyle's Deck 4. Episode 8 of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "Fit for a Queen" 5. Closing credits
